scenarios.title: iPhone-led quarter, one derived share claim, one opinion
scenarios.output_text: Apple's total net sales for the quarter reached $111,184 million, up from $95,359 million a year earlier. iPhone was the primary driver, with iPhone net sales climbing to $56,994 million from $46,841 million. Management attributed the growth to stronger demand for Pro models. iPhone therefore accounted for roughly 51% of total quarterly revenue. We think this concentration makes Apple more exposed to iPhone-cycle risk than peers with more diversified mixes.
